tools.description: The workspace grep, ripgrep-backed: use it instead of grep, rg or find in run_task. For JS/TS semantic references, set mode to references and query to a symbol sN alias or path#qualifiedName; results state compiler project scope and any lexical fallback. Bare-name fallback proposes nextSearches; choose the intended declaration. output files lists every matching file with its matching-line count; count returns totals. context adds surrounding lines to text matches. A match inside a declaration returns that declaration's sN alias with matchLine. Results come in pages (8 matches or 50 files by default); a limited result carries nextSearch. Case is ignored unless caseSensitive. Search results do not authorize edits: read the target first. scope.description: One literal path/glob, or multiple scopes as an array, e.g. ["src","spec"]. A space in one string belongs to that path.

output.description: matches (default): located hits with aliases; files: every matching path with its matching-line count; count: totals only.

caseSensitive.description: Text and regex searches ignore case unless true.

context.description: Lines of surrounding source shown with each text match, grep -C style (12: match, 11- context).

limit.description: Results per page: 8 matches or 50 files by default.

offset.description: Results to skip; a limited result returns the next page as nextSearch.

tools.name: read_code

A line range selects those lines; range also takes an array of up to 8 ranges in one call. Bodies your searches, edits or failing checks hit stay whole. To unfold, read the alias or the line ranges; view raw reads the whole file, and right after a folded view returns only the hidden lines. Results state the lines they hold and expose editTargets and containedBy relationships. Generated outputs and ordinary node_modules reads are excluded. offset.description: Only for declaration continuation; use the offset returned by nextRead.

range.description: Lines to read; an array reads up to 8 ranges in one call.

tools.name: edit_code
tools.description: Atomically apply symbol operations or focused Cline patches. Each operation uses kind "symbol" or "patch"; symbol edits put the edit action in action. target.description: Observed symbol alias. Restricts one Update File patch to this symbol; its header must match the alias path. Omit target for a deliberate file/multi-file patch; explicit headers select those files.

path.description: Target for raw content or a patch without file headers. Explicit patch headers select their own files.

patch.description:

@@

+new line

Do not attach screenshots that show nothing new.
